svg.text: SAdiy on EBAZ4205 (XC7Z010): block diagram and connectivity of the whole design
Source: rtl/fpga/ebaz_sadiy_top.sv, rtl/src/sadiy_top.sv. Generated by rtl/scripts/gen_blockdiagram.py. Pad balls: docs/pinmap.md. Linux EMIO GPIO line = 54 + n.
DDR3, MIO[53:0]: not via the PL
Programmable logic (ebaz_sadiy_top.sv, one clock: FCLK0 100 MHz)
pad cells below: no logic, only IOBUF / OBUFT / direct wires
main ADC of the detector, read by the PS
MII on EMIO, 25 MHz PHY clock out (FCLK1)
SCL R19, SDA P20, CS T20 (SPI1)
T19, P19, U20, U19, V20 (active low)
CE and LD pins on the header
RF in -> PE4302 -> amp -> AD831 mixer
CTRL.pin_owner: PS (bench mode, Linux drives the SPI0 / GPIO lines) or engine (sweep)
PE4302 outputs are tri-stated until driven; default LE / CLK idle levels set here
start, abort, soft_reset, n_entries, timing, owner request / status, counters, error index, irq
tri_o / tri_t out, pad level back
not built yet: det_ext (PL ADC reader), PL access to keys / LEDs
